address: 59-63 Brighton Road, Surbiton, London, KT6 5LR, United Kingdom
bio: Keep your eyes peeled for the tall clock and bell tower which marks out this Indian restaurant just off Surbiton High Street, then feel yourself drawn in by its bright and colourful interior. Kick off with a street food snack, such as koliwada fish with fiery green chutney, then choose from a pan-Indian menu that ranges from the tandoori dishes of the north to the more subtle spicing of the south. The muntjac dum biryani and the coastal lamb curry are two signatures, while bright, distinct flavours and well-balanced spicing run throughout.
